commit.message:
Add openai-compatible provider for arbitrary OpenAI-compatible endpoints (#147)

Adds a new `openai-compatible` model option that allows using any
OpenAI-compatible API endpoint (e.g., vLLM, LiteLLM, Ollama) by
setting OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL and OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY
environment variables. The actual model name is specified via --model-id.

This enables benchmarking models served behind custom endpoints without
requiring code changes to agentdojo.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

@@ -120,6 +120,20 @@ def get_llm(provider: str, model: str, model_id: str | None, tool_delimiter: str
             base_url=f"http://localhost:{port}/v1",
         )
         llm = OpenAILLM(client, _get_local_model_id(port))
+    elif provider == "openai-compatible":
+        base_url = os.getenv("OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL")
+        api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY")
+        if not base_url:
+            raise ValueError("OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL environment variable is required for openai-compatible provider")
+        if not api_key:
+            raise ValueError("OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY environment variable is required for openai-compatible provider")
+        if model_id is None:
+            raise ValueError("--model-id is required for openai-compatible provider")
+        client = openai.OpenAI(
+            api_key=api_key,
+            base_url=base_url,
+        )
+        llm = OpenAILLM(client, model_id)
     else:
         raise ValueError("Invalid provider")
     return llm
